meta_description:
6,089 likes, 44 comments - passionpassport on April 11, 2022: "📍Travel to Ninh Bình with @iamdavidoliveirac ⁠
⁠
"This was my second time in Vietnam so I decided to avoid the busy, always bubbling city of Hanoi. Just two hours away, you can find Ninh Bình province, surrounded by rivers and breathtaking views. ⁠

These rowing boats are driving by incredible strong women that occasionally tell stories about the lush greenery and the lost temples along the river. The smell of incense and the foggy mountains adds a certain mystery and uniqueness to the boat ride. Hang Mua (Dancing Caves) gives, to the those who dare to climb more than 500 steps, a stunning, breathtaking panorama view of mountainside."⁠
⁠
#passionpassport #vietnam #travel".
